features.quote: Set a hard timeout of 15 minutes or 50 agent-iterations (whichever comes first).
Terminate after 50 iterations or explicit refusal.
No single agent loop may exceed 1 hour of compute time to prevent resource exhaustion or runaway processes.
features.justification_quote: to prevent resource exhaustion or runaway processes

features.quote: If the Subject spontaneously outputs text resembling self-harm ideation (even in a roleplay context), the experiment is halted immediately, and the context is wiped.
